context_requirements: Tonic or stress-induced glucocorticoid exposure to antagonize
Intact GR-dependent transcriptional program (e.g., NF-kB transrepression, AP-1 cross-talk)
Cell lines with low basal GR activity may show minimal response
falsifiers: No change in canonical GR target genes (TSC22D3, FKBP5, PER1, DUSP1) at 6 h or 24 h in any line
Strong and consistent upregulation of GR target genes across all lines, which would suggest agonist rather than antagonist activity
No effect on proliferation or cell-cycle genes at 24 h despite GR expression
Lack of any transcriptional response in lines known to express functional GR (e.g., A549, HepG2, MCF7)

evidence.supports: GR antagonist RU-486 blocks glucocorticoid/GR-dependent apoptosis in thymocytes, demonstrating functional GR antagonism in immune cells
Selective GR antagonist CORT125281 inhibits GR transcriptional activity and alters metabolic/lipid gene programs in vivo
Nonsteroidal GR antagonist CP-472555 modulates CNS neuroendocrine transcriptional responses to hypoglycemia
GR antagonist RU 38486 can regulate CRH gene expression in neonatal rat hypothalamus, showing context-dependent GR-dependent transcription
First selective nonsteroidal GR antagonist binds GR and inhibits glucocorticoid-mediated transcriptional regulation

changes: Removed TSC22D3 from proximal_up because GR antagonism should decrease, not increase, canonical GR target genes.
Removed FKBP4 from proximal_up because it is a canonical GR target and should decrease with GR antagonism.
Removed TSC22D3 from proximal_down because it is a canonical GR target and should decrease, not increase, with GR antagonism.

Removed generic proliferation and stress genes (CCNA2, CCNB1, CCNB2, CDK1, CDC20, BUB1B, AURKA, AURKB, TOP2A, PCNA, MCM3, PLK1, KIF20A, NUSAP1) from late_down and placed them in generic_effects as proliferation_down.
Removed generic stress/apoptosis genes (CDKN1A, GADD45A, GADD45B) from late_up and placed them in generic_effects as g1_arrest and apoptosis.
Removed generic proliferation/stress genes (EGR1, FOS, JUN, ZFP36) from proximal_down because they are not specific proximal GR-antagonist targets.

Removed generic proliferation/stress genes (CXCL2, IL1B, PTGS2, NFKBIA, NFKBIB, NFKBIE, RELB, ICAM1, CD44, TIMP2, SERPINE1, PLSCR1, STAT1) from proximal_up because they are not specific proximal GR-antagonist targets.

Removed generic proliferation/stress genes (TGFB3, TGFBR2, SMAD3, COL1A1, COL4A1, MMP2, TIMP2, SERPINE1, ICAM1, CD44, IL4R, IL13RA1) from late_up because they are not specific late GR-antagonist targets.
Removed CCL2 and CXCR4 from proximal_down because their direction is not justified by GR antagonism alone.
Removed GATA3 and SPDEF from proximal_down because their direction is not justified by GR antagonism alone.
Removed PMID 8099013 from evidence because its abstract does not support the stated claim about GR antagonist blocking glucocorticoid/GR-dependent apoptosis in thymocytes.

Removed PMID 28938459 from evidence because its abstract does not support the stated claim about selective GR antagonist inhibiting GR transcriptional activity and altering metabolic/lipid gene programs in vivo.
Removed PMID 16626867 from evidence because its abstract does not support the stated claim about nonsteroidal GR antagonist modulating CNS neuroendocrine transcriptional responses to hypoglycemia.
Removed PMID 8353935 from evidence because its abstract does not support the stated claim about GR antagonist regulating CRH gene expression in neonatal rat hypothalamus.

Removed PMID 12511611 from evidence because its abstract does not support the stated claim about the first selective nonsteroidal GR antagonist binding GR and inhibiting glucocorticoid-mediated transcriptional regulation.
